lore:
A country girl from the provinces, dressed in an extravagant gown and adorned with gold and silver jewelry, sneaks into the world of the elite with a feather fan in hand...
Nothing could be more improper. Someone of inferior status trespassing among our ranks is simply scandalous!
I say, there should be mandatory identification badges displaying one's social standing, so such people cannot be mistaken for one of us.

—Duke Philip Harold

If you live in Londinium, you must be familiar with the so-called "Sorel Effect."
Still worried that your clothes will not sell? You had better pray that you have connections enough to win Lady Sorel's favor. Even a ridiculously silly pig-tail dress hat will sell like hotcakes if placed on Lady Sorel's head.
She is the pop idol of the new era.

—"The Fame Quiz of Lady Sorel," <Italic:The Lady's Guide>

It was a clear summer night.
We sat together on the marble-paved terrace, sipping aged noble botrytis wine and discussing poetry and world peace.
And then something happened @4
Get to the point? Ahem, my apologies...
In short, this woman cheated me out of three thousand Leo Fang, two properties in Sc@1and, and a sincere heart!

—A heartbroken viscount who wishes to remain anonymous
